note: One cassette covering every kind of call a played campaign makes: the scene turn itself, then the absorb pass and the refreshes that hang off it, plus the two JSON side-calls (scene suggestions, tagline). Entries are matched on a phrase from the prompt that OWNS that call — see tests/test_llm_fakes.py, which renders each template and fails if its phrase has moved. Replies are hand-authored, never recorded from a provider, and are written against the frozen campaign in fixtures/frozen_campaign (ids: the-debt, salt-owed, seraphine, winifred).
